description: Set spending caps. Pass per_tx/daily/monthly in USD ('none' disables an axis); omit an axis to leave it unchanged. RAISING or REMOVING a cap requires confirm: true (returns needs_confirmation otherwise). Tightening is free.

confirm.description: Required true to RAISE or REMOVE a cap (a loosening change).

daily.description: Daily cap in USD, or 'none' to disable. Omit to leave unchanged.

monthly.description: Monthly cap in USD, or 'none' to disable. Omit to leave unchanged.

per_tx.description: Per-transaction cap in USD, or 'none' to disable. Omit to leave unchanged.

name: xenarch_agent_set_caps
